note: Registry of UI/effect sources. Every entry was HTTP-verified on the date in `verified`. Add new entries with scripts/add_source.py (it probes and fills `access` automatically). See references/maintaining.md.

access_methods.llms-full: curl the site's /llms-full.txt — full source dump of every component in one file. Cheapest and best when it exists.
access_methods.llms-txt: curl the site's /llms.txt — index + prose contract, links to per-item pages. Read this before anything else.
access_methods.md-suffix: Append `.md` to a page URL to get a lightweight markdown twin instead of the JS app.
access_methods.shadcn-registry: `npx shadcn@latest add @<ns>/<item>` installs into the project. `curl <base>/registry.json` lists every item; `curl <base>/<item>.json` returns the item WITH full file contents inline — read source without installing.
access_methods.registry-json: Site exposes its own machine-readable JSON catalog at a fixed URL.
access_methods.mcp: MCP server — the agent searches/installs through tools. Needs one-time setup by the user.
access_methods.rest-api: Documented HTTP API (often with an OpenAPI spec).
access_methods.git-clone: Clone the repo and read/copy files. Use when there is no machine index or the site blocks bots.
access_methods.gh-api: GitHub REST API (contents / search / org repos) — enumerate without cloning.
access_methods.npm: Published package — install and use directly instead of copying source.
access_methods.cdn: Drop-in <script> or <link> from a CDN, no build step.
access_methods.browse: gstack /browse headless Chromium renders it fine. Use `$B goto`, `$B text`, `$B html <sel>`, `$B snapshot -i`.
access_methods.browse-headed: Bot protection (Cloudflare) blocks headless AND curl. Needs `browse --headed`, `$B handoff`, or the user.
access_methods.manual: No automatable path — the user opens it and pastes.
